_about: Seed claims taken from docs/research/PUBLICATION_READINESS.md at 8e5bc2e, with the evidence that already existed. C-EDGE10 is seeded with the status that document gave it, so the worked example shows how ResearchOS handles it. The C-EDGE10 llm row illustrates that a model's opinion is stored as qualitative_llm_review and never counts as numerical evidence.

claims.text: On measured melting point (Bradley, known formula, E3a), TIa_composition beats composition: dR2 +0.085 [0.065, 0.106], 15/15 folds.
claims.scope: MP only; exploratory dated amendment (fc69883), not third-party preregistration

evidence.summary: fold metrics and corrected-t interval recomputed from predictions by a separate script; max abs diff 0.0
negative control (y permuted within formula) gives no spurious gain: -0.028 [-0.052, -0.004]

claims.text: The gain is carried by 10 numbers (9 degree-pair edge counts + max degree).

evidence.summary: an assistant summarised edgetypes_composition >= TIa_composition as 'carries the whole gain'

claims.text: The external melting-point test (Bradley PHYSPROP-free -> OPERA PHYSPROP) is source-disjoint.
claims.scope: record level only; reference-level independence not shown (OPERA has no reference field)
limitations: source-disjoint must not be reported as independent

evidence.summary: training set excludes every PHYSPROP record; test is OPERA PHYSPROP MP
evidence.license_note: OPERA per-molecule predictions are not redistributed (terms unresolved)

claims.text: For OPERA logP, TIa_composition adds nothing practically meaningful beyond composition (90% CIs inside +/-0.05).
